html:
A singer from Dakar who made mbalax, a dance music built on Wolof sabar drums and the songs of griots, Senegal's popular sound from the late 1970s.

With his band Super Etoile he toured the world with Peter Gabriel in the 1980s, and his duet 7 Seconds with Neneh Cherry (1994) was an international hit. He built a media business in Dakar and was minister of culture and tourism from 2012. His songs, often on politics and on Amadou Bamba, are known across French-speaking Africa. See also Fela Kuti and world music.
